theorems.statement: ∀ (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Algebra A B] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module B M] [IsScalarTower A B M] (s : CompositionSeries (Submodule B M)) (p : Fin s.length → IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum B), s.head = ⊥ → s.last = ⊤ → (∀ i : Fin s.length, Nonempty ((↥(s i.succ) ⧸ (s i.castSucc).comap (s i.succ).subtype) ≃ₗ[B] (B ⧸ (p i).asIdeal))) → Module.length A M = Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin s.length => Module.length A (B ⧸ (p i).asIdeal))
theorems.natural_summary: Restrict each canonical short exact sequence and residue-factor equivalence to A. Length additivity gives the successive length identities. Sum them by induction in ℕ∞, then identify the bottom endpoint with zero and the top endpoint with M. This matches the parent-supplied proof, includes the empty series, and requires no finiteness or cancellation.
